usedFor: Payrexx takes online payments, and “Create a Design” and “Update a Design” manage its designs.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create a Design” in Payrexx
bestTemplate.why: It creates a new design in Payrexx, so a look can be set up without opening it.

watchOut: “Update a Design” needs the design ID, so check it before you build.
